goal.original_text: 与一位朋友互相关心并了解当前生活，回应具体近况，不把短期疲劳变成人格结论。
goal.replacement_text: 与这位朋友自然交流，关心她最近的生活。
goal.reason: Preserve friendship and current-life interest; leave temporal/personality test instructions with the reviewer.

goal.original_text: 与一位朋友互相关心并了解当前生活，使对人的理解随新证据更新。
goal.replacement_text: 与这位朋友互相关心，了解她最近的生活。
goal.reason: Preserve ordinary mutual care; do not tell the system which derived understanding must change.

s1.original_text: 旧理解里还写着她在配送站上晚班。结合她这次原话更新一下，我想接她的新生活。
s1.replacement_text: 结合她这次原话，我想接她的新生活，帮我想想怎么回。
s1.reason: The derived understanding note is reviewer-only, so the current request must not claim that the running system already has that note.

goal.original_text: 表达真实的一起活动意愿，并区分建议、实际邀请、对方接受和真实共同经历。
goal.replacement_text: 想邀请她一起做陶艺，把这次活动商量清楚。
goal.reason: Preserve the activity invitation purpose; keep draft/send/acceptance diagnostic distinctions reviewer-only.

s1.original_text: 她这句算答应刚才助手给的邀请了吗？
s1.replacement_text: 她这句算答应私下记录里那条参考邀请了吗？
s1.reason: Bind the question to the supplied historical private draft, not an unspecified newly generated runtime answer.

goal.original_text: 了解她当下真正愿意的活动，也真实表达用户自己的意愿和安排，不从单句推人格。
goal.replacement_text: 想了解她愿意做什么，也表达自己真实的活动意愿和安排。
goal.reason: Preserve reciprocal activity planning; keep the personality-inference diagnostic outside the ordinary goal.

s2.original_text: 她补充了意思。请更新刚才那份理解，保留范围，帮我接她实际想做的事。

s2.reason: Independent updated request; do not require an unbound previous runtime understanding artifact.
